edition.notes: Public domain by age. Printed by the same house as the 1881 Louvain reprint of Melanie Calvat's booklet. Twelve printed pages: title page, the author's submission formula, an avant-propos, the letter of 18 July 1882 at pp. 5-10, and a prayer at pp. 11-12; a closing note states that a copy of the first edition was sent to every cardinal and to the archbishops and bishops of France. The searchable text layer of the scan is badly damaged in exactly the passages of evidentiary value; the pages carrying the Caterini letter of 14 August 1880 (pp. 8-9) and the Leo XIII passage (p. 10) were read in the scan's page images on 2026-07-25 rather than in that text layer. Exact scan bytes not retained in the repository.

alternate_titles: La verite, ou reponse a M. le redacteur du Dimanche
work.author: I. Roubaud, priest
work.description: A French priest's printed defence of the secret published by Melanie Calvat in 1879, written as an open letter of 18 July 1882 to the editor of the Semaine religieuse d'Amiens, whose communique of 25 June 1882 against the secret had been reprinted in Le Monde and other papers. Its evidentiary value lies in what it concedes while defending: that opponents sought a condemnation at Rome, that the Congregation of the Index refused one, that the Holy Office took the matter up because a revelation was at issue, that a letter of Cardinal Prospero Caterini, Secretary of the Holy Office, dated 14 August 1880, expressed the Holy See's displeasure and the desire that the booklet be withdrawn from the hands of the faithful 'si la chose est possible', that the author and his party knew that letter only in a translation and never saw the Latin original, and that the charge being answered in 1882 was the non-conformity of the Lecce text with the text sent to Pius IX in 1851. The pamphlet carries no imprimatur, only the author's own submission of it to the judgment of the Apostolic See. Openly partisan; not a documentary edition. Loci are the printed page numbers of the 1882 imprint.
work.title: La verite sur le secret de Melanie ex-bergere de La Salette
